d:
This is a project to justify saving his new Quna locally that got way out of hand. Eight years of Twitter activity have been filtered down to this gallery, a folder of sketches (mainly covering 2018-2022), and a folder of crops and frames announcing his registration for Comiket/Zesshou Stage panels.

All images are assumed to be about equal to a pixiv master1200 upload, but are the highest available resolutions since one-third of the associated skeb request pages are Private and another third have been deleted outright. Have fun tracking down recipients' uploads for the final third.

Some of the early Symphogear images are recognizable from MAIDEN DEFEAT:
https://e-hentai.org/g/2747374/2d16a2ec10/
They were adapted from the skeb recipients' full resolution versions, but more heavily censored in compliance with physical doujin laws. To our knowledge, Gummy-Rise and collaboration partners do not release digital versions.

Support the artist, somehow:
https://x.com/gummy1024
https://skeb.jp/@gummy1024
https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/7129 (idle since 2023, and only updated once every 2 years before that)
https://misskey.io/@gummy1024 (JPN IP and probably also tax identification required)
